title: A non-fraud write-off on a loan MARKED CHARGED OFF credits the 83.57 principal and 1.47 interest to their charge-off income accounts and debits the 85.04 total ONCE to LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF (loan 7 L27)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a write-off posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF, under createJournalEntriesForWriteOffsWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the Tier-D MNT write-off replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_INTEREST_RECALCULATION_ZERO_INTEREST_CHARGE_OFF / product 67) at the write-off transaction. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's write-off transaction id 27 (externalId L27, type loanTransactionType.writeOff, fraud false, chargedOff true): principalPortion 83.57 -> "8357", interestPortion 1.47 -> "147" minor units; feeChargesPortion, penaltyChargesPortion and overpaymentPortion are 0 and are omitted. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.fraud is the loan's observed fraud flag false. request.charged_off_write_off_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_INTEREST_RECALCULATION_ZERO_INTEREST_CHARGE_OFF.json: chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 20, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 16, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 11, writeOffAccountId 19, fundSourceAccountId 5. expect.charged_off_write_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the three L27 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 65 CREDIT account 18 83.57, JE 66 CREDIT account 20 1.47, JE 67 DEBIT account 19 85.04. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charged-off write-off with a fractional minor-unit principal and interest CREDITS each to its distinct charge-off account at the exact integer minor unit (8357 / 147), then DEBITs the total ONCE to losses-written-off (8504), with the credits before the single debit. It discriminates a port that rounds or drops sub-major-unit residue (the amounts are not whole major units), that posts one debit per portion, or that posts the fund-source debits. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the fraud branch (LN-TD-WO-loan-9-chargedoff-writeoff-fraud) and the same-account merge (LN-TD-WO-loan-4-chargedoff-writeoff-merged); fee/penalty/overpayment are zero here. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files; 83.57 and 1.47 are exact decimal parses to integer minor units, never floats.
